relevant_laws.quote: The parking of vehicles is prohibited or restricted in certain zones as set forth in this Section. The location of such zones shall be established by posting appropriate signage or other durable markings, by painting curbs or the edges of road surfaces in accordance with the colors listed below, or by a combination thereof: Yellow indicates a zone for: (1) Commercial vehicles to stop, stand or park for the purpose of loading or unloading freight in accordance with the conditions and times posted on an accompanying sign; and (2) Taxicabs to stop, stand, park for the purpose of loading, unloading or waiting for passengers in accordance with the conditions and times posted on an accompanying sign.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: source-gated commercial freight loading or unloading at a signed yellow curb
relevant_laws.notes: Municipal commercial status, freight purpose, original zone, sign and civil-time sources must be reviewed.
